prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1305; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was driving through the intersection in Pasadena, Texas, when a vehicle coming from my right struck the side of my car. The impact pushed my car sideways and I felt a sharp pain in my left shoulder right away. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived and gave them my account. Afterward I remembered a few smaller details, such as the other car's speed and the color of the traffic light, and I told the adjuster about them when I was asked. Apart from those added points, my description of what happened has not changed. I am listed as a member of the policyholder's household and I live at the same address, so I am submitting this claim as a covered household driver.
